environment: Official Offline eBIRForms HTA hosted by C:\Windows\SysWOW64\mshta.exe
data_policy: Dummy profile only; no online submission was confirmed.

observations.setup: In Edit mode, clear frm1701q:txtYear while leaving the remaining dummy return state intact, then click Validate.
observations.observed_behavior: Validation stopped at the year check and showed the exact first-error dialog.
observations.exact_message: Please enter a valid year in Item 1.
observations.restoration: The year was restored to 2026 immediately after observation. Save was not clicked.

observations.setup: The dummy return contained Item 11 = 00/01/1990 and otherwise passed the ordered Validate sequence.
observations.observed_behavior: The invalid month 00 was accepted and the official UI reported validation success.
observations.exact_message: Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.

observations.setup: Validate a dummy return with no spouse, dismiss the success dialog, click Edit, and inspect page 2.
observations.observed_behavior: Items 55B, 56B, 57B, 58B, 60B, 61B, 64B, 65B, and 66B were enabled. Item 59B remained disabled.

observations.setup: Use dummy spouse TIN 123-456-788, leave the spouse branch code blank, select RDO 018, Professional, and ATC II014, provide a nonempty dummy spouse name, and leave both Item 25A choices blank.
observations.observed_behavior: The blank spouse branch code and blank Item 25A both passed the ordered Validate sequence.
observations.exact_message: Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.

observations.setup: After successful validation, click Submit / Final Copy first with Amended Return = No and then with Amended Return = Yes.
observations.observed_behavior: The non-amended attempt showed the existing-file/amended-return warning. The amended attempt reached an explicit online-submission confirmation. Cancel was selected; the online action was not confirmed. No 1701Q savefile or IAF_RDO_Copy timestamp changed.
exact_messages: If your intention is to make an amended return, kindly tick Amended Return to 'Yes' before hitting 'Save'or'Final Copy' or 'Submit'.
Please ensure that you have INTERNET access and a VALID email address is indicated in your tax return. Are you sure you want to submit?
observations.safety_boundary: The second dialog was canceled because online submission is outside the research scope. txtFinalFlag and reopen behavior after confirmed submission were not observed.
